weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 抓住今天充滿活力的能量，白羊座，讓它推動你前進！這是放鬆和享受自己的絕佳時刻。但是，請注意，您周圍的人可能會感到比平常更緊張，因此您的自然適應能力會派上用場。保持冷靜和隨和，有助於為身邊的每個人營造更輕鬆的氛圍。
aries.horoscope_en: Seize the vibrant energy of today, Aries, and let it propel you forward! It's an excellent moment to let loose and enjoy yourself. However, be aware that those around you might be feeling a bit more tense than normal, so your natural adaptability will come in handy. By staying calm and easygoing, you'll help create a more relaxed atmosphere for everyone around you.

taurus.horoscope: 今天，金牛座，你可能會對周圍的人的匆忙感到有點惱怒。擁抱快速的能量流，以保持在迴圈中。如果你潛入計劃外的活動，這是完全可以的；事實上，你會發現，在這樣的一天，一點點的自發性可以帶來極大的快樂。準備好迎接驚喜吧！
taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, you may feel a bit exasperated by the rush of those around you. Embrace the swift current of energy to stay in the loop. It's perfectly fine if you dive into unplanned activities; in fact, you'll discover that a little spontaneity can bring great joy on a day like this. Be ready for surprises!

gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, you might find yourself at odds with others. The root of the tension is likely their self-centeredness, contrasting with your broader concern for the group. It’s important to practice patience as they seek your attention. However, there's a vibrant energy surrounding you that will infuse your day with enthusiasm and excitement.

cancer.horoscope_en: Start your day off on a positive note, Cancer! Your kindness and authenticity will shine brightly today. Those around you may require a bit more emotional support than usual, so make sure to nurture the feelings of your loved ones. Just remember to protect your own energy and not become overwhelmed. Embrace the vibrant, joyful spirit of the day to recharge your own batteries.

leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, brace yourself for some unforeseen tension that may arise unexpectedly. Your emotions are likely to be heightened, and your assertive nature might rub some people the wrong way. Be prepared for sudden reactions from others, as the atmosphere could shift quickly. The day carries a fast-moving energy that will be difficult to overlook.

virgo.horoscope_en: Today, Virgo, your methodical pace may face some resistance. Others might be eager for your attention and resources. You might find that even a simple decision at the coffee shop could draw impatient glares from those waiting behind you.

Don't hesitate to indulge in your style today—embrace the opportunity to shine and make a statement wherever you venture.

scorpio.horoscope_en: Stay on your toes today, Scorpio, as the pace is likely to pick up. If you’re eager to make your voice heard, don’t hesitate to take the initiative and step forward.

Prepare to confront your challenges head-on. Trust in the skills you've honed. You possess a heightened sense of awareness that will aid you in overcoming obstacles. Leverage this keen perception of the energies surrounding you to turn the tide in your favor.

Instead, it's likely that innovative gadgets and modern technological shortcuts will steal the spotlight. This is a perfect example of how the latest and greatest can outshine the outdated and sluggish. It's time to consider an upgrade to your approach—why wait when you can embrace the change now?

Completing your tasks before indulging in socializing will lead to the most satisfying outcomes.

pisces.horoscope_en: Today, Pisces, you might find yourself swinging to extremes in various aspects of your life. However, be prepared for resistance at every corner. A strong sense of stubbornness seems to permeate the atmosphere, affecting not just you but those around you as well. Remember, if you're seeking collaboration and solutions, embracing compromise is essential. Make an effort to acknowledge and consider the needs of others too.
